title: Improved Basophil Activation Test (BAT) in the Diagnostics of Drug Allergy
brief_summary: Current study evaluates the use of the improved Basophil Activation Test (BAT) in the diagnostics of IgE-mediated allergy to antibiotics and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).
study_population: Patients with the suspected allergy to antibiotics or NSAIDs
